issue.title: [agent-runtime 02/08] Push live run events and repair interrupted runs at startup (#117)

body:
Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #321

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Branch pushed successfully to `bb/relay-117-agent-runtime-02-08-push-live-run-even-thr_rx7w49ymgx`.

## Summary

Implements issue #117: the live push hook and startup repair sweep that build on #228's `packages/agent-runtime` lifecycle adapter.

**Live push hook** — `runAgentSession` now publishes every message it observes, including `message_update` streaming deltas, as a new `agent_run_event` realtime NOTIFY (`@semprec/realtime`'s `RealtimeMessage` union). This is best-effort (a failed publish is logged, never fails the run) and happens for every message kind, while persistence to `agent_run_events` still skips `message_update` — so deltas are observable live but absent from Postgres, per the acceptance criteria.

**Startup repair sweep** — new `repairInterruptedRuns(pool)` exported from `@semprec/agent-runtime`, backed by a new `listRunningAgentRuns` query in `@semprec/data`. In one transaction it:
1. Closes every `agent_runs` row still `status='running'` as `status='error'`, `finished_at=now()`, `result='interrupted_by_restart'`.
2. For each such run whose last `agent_run_events` row is an unpaired `tool_use`, appends a synthetic `tool_result` (carrying over the original tool-call fields, marked `error: true`) so the transcript's tool-calling invariant holds.

This is a ready-to-call primitive; no `semprec-agents` service process exists yet in the repo to invoke it at boot or to wire the push into a live server, consistent with #228 also having no live caller yet.

**Testing**: added integration tests for both the push hook (via a real LISTEN/NOTIFY round trip) and the repair sweep (orphan detection, synthetic tool_result insertion/non-insertion, no-op cases). Full suite verified in this session: build ✅, `check:boundaries` ✅, unit 83/83 ✅, integration 431/431 ✅, e2e 5/5 ✅.

Pull request: #321

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed the code-review follow-up commit to the existing branch `bb/relay-117-agent-runtime-02-08-push-live-run-even-thr_rx7w49ymgx` (same branch backing PR #321).

## Summary

This push addresses the CI code-review feedback on PR #321:

- **High-severity fix**: `startupRepair.ts` no longer blindly casts the untyped JSONB `payload` to `Record<string, unknown>` — it now validates the value is a plain object first, falling back to `{}` for a malformed row instead of risking a runtime crash. Added a regression test with a non-object payload.
- **Run-status push criterion**: the lifecycle adapter now also emits a `run_status` realtime event for the run's own lifecycle transitions (start → `running`, finish → `done`/`error`), on top of the mid-session `run_status` `AgentMessage` kind it already pushed — covering every live event category the issue lists. Deduplicated the publish-with-best-effort-catch logic into one helper.
- **Flaky test fix**: replaced the fixed 50ms sleep waiting for NOTIFY delivery with a bounded poll loop, and extended assertions to cover the new `run_status` pushes.
- **Startup-wiring criterion**: confirmed via the issue tracker that the actual `services/semprec-agents` composition root is issue #91's explicit deliverable (not #117's, and not yet built anywhere in the repo — `backend/services/` is still empty). Building a stand-in service now would risk conflicting with #91's real design. Instead, documented in `repairInterruptedRuns`'s docstring that #91 is the intended caller, ready to wire in once that composition root exists.

Verified before pushing: `tsc --noEmit` clean, `check:boundaries` clean, full suite green — unit 83/83, integration 432/432, e2e 5/5.
